# The Tale of the First Shadow

In the time before time, when the world was newly born, there lived a young weaver named Solara who crafted light itself into brilliant tapestries. Her creations illuminated the world, bringing warmth and joy to all living things.

One day, Solara grew curious about the spaces between her threads of light. "What exists in these gaps?" she wondered. Against the warnings of the elder weavers, she pulled at the fabric of her greatest tapestry, creating a hole where no light could reach.

From this void emerged the first shadow—a gentle, dancing form that followed her every movement. Terrified, Solara tried to weave it away with more light, but the shadow only grew stronger, feeding on the contrast.

The shadow spoke softly: "Do not fear me. I am your complement, not your enemy. Without me, your light has no form or definition. I give your brilliance meaning."

Solara understood. She wove the shadow into her tapestries, creating depth and beauty previously unknown. From that day forward, every source of light cast its shadow, and the world gained dimension.

This is why we cherish both sunshine and shade, for neither can exist in its full glory without the other.
